description: Type deleting an instance's last cluster (HTTP 400 FAILED_PRECONDITION). It surfaced as a generic BadRequest, so the Cluster provider matched message strings to tell it apart from malformed requests.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The cluster is the instance's last LIVE cluster and cannot be deleted on its own; delete the instance instead (HTTP 400 FAILED_PRECONDITION: 'Cannot delete the last LIVE Cluster in an Instance'). Not retryable.

message.includes: Cannot delete the last LIVE Cluster
